scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @defense/server" "npm run dev --workspace @defense/web"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @defense/web
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @defense/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @defense/server && npm run build --workspace @defense/web
